summary: Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing highlights the successful completion of a business combination with dMY Squared Technology Group, Inc., which began trading on March 20, 2026. It reports an operating loss of $6.5 million, net loss of $3.6 million, and strategic agreements with IonQ and other hardware providers. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present; this is a routine earnings report.
